entries.summary: Expect to see quite a few websites serving "404" or "Page Not Found" errors today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild.

entries.title: “Next Exploit Opportunities”: How a Threat Actor Used AI to Help Plan and Execute Multiple Types of Cybercrime Activities
entries.summary: An investigation into a threat actor bypassing AI safety controls to coordinate credential theft, VoIP fraud planning, and database exfiltration.

entries.title: Critical security issue affecting PHP
entries.summary: Updated: The NCSC is encouraging UK organisations to take immediate action to mitigate a security issue affecting PHP (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619).

entries.title: Active Exploitation of May 2026 PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 (Updated October 20)
entries.summary: Ransomware operators including Spikey Scorpius (aka Qilin) and Tarnished Scorpius (aka Inc) are exploiting PAN-OS vulnerability CVE-2026-0257.

entries.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
entries.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. entries.title: Top 5 Initial Access Threat Vectors Observed by Unit 42 in September 2026

entries.summary: We investigated an intrusion where attackers exploited CVE-2024-47575 to target 500+ firewalls and deploy PEERSTITCH, a memory-resident ARM64 malware.

entries.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
entries.summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions.

entries.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
entries.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.

entries.title: The Noise Inside the Network: How an Unsophisticated Attack Exposed a Third-Party Risk
entries.summary: Unit 42 dissects a cyberattack targeting a European bank's IT infrastructure, delivering concrete defense strategies to help organizations detect and counter comparable threats.

entries.title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm
entries.summary: Agents with the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) on Thursday arrested the co-founder of a Canadian cybersecurity firm in connection with an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently relieved the FBI of sensitive data on thousands of agents, multiple sources tell KrebsOnSecurity.

entries.title: China-linked malicious actors called out by UK and international partners for targeting sensitive data globally
entries.summary: Joint advisory with international partners highlights malicious targeting of organisations from a range of sectors across the globe.

entries.summary: Unit 42 details how threat actors leverage Web3 infrastructure and open-source supply chain attacks to breach enterprise cloud environments

entries.summary: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang. entries.title: Incident affecting ASOS customers
entries.summary: ASOS has said it is investigating a cyber incident and that some customer personal information may have been accessed.

entries.title: Blinder Tunnel Campaign Targets Iraqi Infrastructure
entries.summary: Analysis of Blinder Tunnel, an Iran-nexus campaign using fake Dubai Airports recruitment lures and GitHub C2 malware to target critical infrastructure.

entries.title: OperTraitors: How Kubernetes Operators Betray Your Security Posture
entries.summary: We introduce OperTraitor, a tool to audit privileges of Kubernetes operators, identify excessive RBAC risks, and secure non-human identities.

entries.title: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation
entries.summary: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested a 23-year-old convicted cybercriminal on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by the prolific hacker group ShinyHunters. In the days immediately following the suspect's arrest, remaining ShinyHunters members dramatically escalated their attacks, stealing highly sensitive data from the FBI and extorting the Russian ransomware group Cl0p.

entries.title: Exploitation of vulnerabilities affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway
entries.summary: The NCSC is urging UK organisations to promptly mitigate vulnerabilities affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway, two of which are being actively exploited.

entries.title: U.S. Soldier Gets 70 Months in Prison for AT&T, Verizon Extortions
entries.summary: A U.S. Army soldier who pleaded guilty to hacking into multiple telecommunications companies and stealing mobile call and text metadata for more than 100 million AT&T customers in 2024 was sentenced to 70 months in federal prison today and ordered to pay nearly $300,000 in restitution to victims.

entries.summary: The consumer data broker Radaris.com has long had a reputation for ignoring requests to remove personal information from its vast empire of people-search services online.
